svg.text: Drafting: the tow and the slingshot
Tucked in: 2 cells or fewer behind a car in your own lane, judged at the end of a move.
Once: the next move wears less. Twice in a row: the next lane change is free.
The number is the gap to the car ahead. Not in the next lane, not further back.
On the outer lane's bend: counted in cells, not by the number in the dot
Lane 3 has 32 cells, so two neighbours can share a forwardIndex (10 and 10). The gap is still 1.
What the run buys on your next move
Run 1: the last move ended tucked in
4-cell move in your lane: fuel 1 (tow discount)
Run 2: tucked in twice in a row: the slingshot
4-cell move in your lane: fuel 1 (tow discount)
